# WeightedRoller.WeightTable

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Generation` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public readonly struct WeightedRoller.WeightTable
```

A weight table with its ordering and running totals already resolved. Both are fixed properties of the cookbook, so a caller that rolls the same table repeatedly should [`WeightedRoller.Prepare()`](Nfty.Core.Generation.WeightedRoller.md#m-prepare-system-collections-generic-ireadonlydictionary-2d4b54) it once and roll the result, instead of re-sorting and re-summing on every draw.
